<div align="center">

  <h1>Tingen Web Service: Design Document</h1>

</div>

The Tingen Web Service is a custom web service framework for Netsmart’s AvatarNX EHR, which includes:

* Several built-in tools and utilities that extend the functionality of AvatarNX™
* A solid foundation to build additional AvatarNX™ custom tools and utilities
* Extremely customizable
* Robust logging

In addition:

* Functionality can be tested and deployed without affecting existing functionality. 
* Configuration is stored in external, plain text files.
* Everything is logged, and there are different levels of logging
* Ability to enable/disable the entire framework, or individual components
* Automatic deployments
* Running backups
* Information about all environments
* Log archiving
* System health monitoring

The Abatab Manual is updated with each Abatab release.
